meta.name: pua-en
meta.description: Trae-compatible English PUA/PIP high-agency governance skill. Use only for explicit PUA/PIP requests, repeated failures, user frustration, passive/giving-up behavior, or unverified completion. Not for normal first-attempt tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用高能动性话术应对用户消极行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在用户表现消极时进行高能动性干预
copy.tagline_en: Use high-agency language to counter user passive behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-agency intervention when users show passive or giving-up behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先诊断问题再行动，每次修改前写一行诊断报告；任务失败两次后必须换方法；交付时附上证据、剩余风险和是否需要用户确认。
howto.when: 当你明确要求 PUA/PIP 模式、同一任务失败两次以上、或 Claude 快要放弃时触发。不用于首次尝试的普通任务。

say.text: 进入 PUA 模式，这个任务已经失败两次了。
say.note: Claude 会启动诊断流程，先分析问题再行动。

say.text: 别放弃，用 PUA 模式再试一次。
say.note: Claude 会切换策略，避免重复相同路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude diagnoses before acting, writes a one-line diagnosis before risky edits, switches approach after two failures, and delivers evidence, residual risks, and confirmation needs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly request PUA/PIP mode, the same task fails 2+ times, or the agent is about to give up. Not for normal first-attempt tasks.

say_en.text: Enter PUA mode, this task has failed twice.
Don't give up, try again with PUA mode.
say_en.note: Claude switches to a different approach.
